questions.stem: To make lead iodide by precipitation, which pair of reactants should be used?

options.text: Lead nitrate solution and potassium iodide solution

questions.explanation: Lead iodide (PbI₂) is insoluble, so it must be made by precipitation. Both reactants must be soluble: lead nitrate (soluble, as all nitrates are) and potassium iodide (soluble, as all potassium salts are). Pb(NO₃)₂(aq) + 2KI(aq) → PbI₂(s) + 2KNO₃(aq).
